WITH retried AS (
                 UPDATE jobs
                 SET status = 'queued',
                     run_at = now() + $4::bigint * interval '1 millisecond',
                     claimed_by = NULL,
                     lease_expires_at = NULL,
                     error = $5
                 WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'running' AND claimed_by = $2 AND attempt = $3
                 RETURNING plan_id
             )
             SELECT pg_notify($6, plan_id::text) FROM retried
